topic: Qm31 sampler: external P and CM31.new
decision: The cost-probe emission PCQK_E015 (ON, original Aeneas, 4bb3b3f) leaves aspis_core::field::P (axiom Result U32) and CM31::new as externals. In the fresh namespace they are instantiated to ok gate P and the gate CM31.new (PRVD_ConstBind). Classes: CONDITIONAL_ON_BINDING for qm31_div_pass family, digits, sample; the instantiation equals frozen aspis-core only by the earlier field.P / CM31.new equalities (PCQF_E002..E007, P2f), not re-proved here.

Gate names Accumulator, BatchedWeights, Prepared correspond to fresh verifier.Accumulator, verifier.BatchedWeights, verifier.Prepared of PCVJ_E002 (the generator name-map only aliases; the three equivalences are hand-assembled from the fresh text). transport.Variant gate carries a hand discriminant instance; only the type is compared (HM-G is not used).

Four generator passes with four fresh Types texts (PCVT_E014, PCVX_E006, PCVX_E012 original Aeneas; PCVL_E003 extended). Inductives whose constructors mention same-file types were skipped by the generator (text-identical only); equivalences hand-assembled with the already proved component equivalences. The gate read_discriminant instances are not compared (HM-G).

Constants from PCQF_E003/E004/E010 (ON, 4bb3b3f); M31.to_le_bytes from PCWM_E001 (ON, original Aeneas, aspis-core). encode_digest_canonical family: fresh E002 (original Aeneas, ON via patch env) is the same text as the gate over the HM-B/HM-D externals; the aspis-core method is an external in E002 and is bound to the E001 emission (CONDITIONAL_ON_BINDING).

Reconstruction route (owner decision 2026-11-10) used for exactly this module: ReconstructedSource, not frozen-equal. values_owned_reference needs the error carrier mapped (local enum to the frozen compact.CodecError); proved with the unmapped statements for the seven carrier-free definitions.
CANNOT_EXTRACT (fold with fn item and closure arguments). The gate loops and _entry wrappers are GATE_ONLY_HELPERs with no frozen counterpart. Counted OPEN; nothing proposed.
No counterpart in the pin (4bb3b3f) or Pool b936275; sources are tools crates. NO_FROZEN_COUNTERPART, counted OPEN. Reconstruction is not permitted for these (owner decision); no trust row proposed.

E003 spec defect (include after the cargo separator), E004 stager K2 (stable dest-file), E005/E006 Aeneas CANNOT_EXTRACT; Lean L003, L009, L011 text defects; L013-L018 the values_owned_reference proof shapes, L019 closed. None retired a shape class; no scope was killed by memory or time.
